title: Prove no second after-cover keeps the one-weight gap and equals C (no κ)
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped proof. No new κ. The selected conditional exponent stays **781451/250000000**.

The selected ordinary formula reads one field, `ordinary_BIT.after_cover`. The thinned controller writes it once, from `C1=0.00345` (`69/20000`). The one-weight delayed-cover proof keeps `before > after`, with before-cover `C0=3459/1000000`. The formula is strictly increasing, and

    ordinary(C0) = 8613294599/2500000000000

is strictly below the recorded PR5679 component

    C = 3507410738409/1000000000000000.

Every rational cover strictly below `C0` therefore misses `C`. The unique cover that hits `C`, `3507256898809/996000000000000`, lies strictly above `C0`, so the positive-gap comparison does not apply to it.

The second source assignment authenticated here is the retained delayed-cover bridge: `after = Q(11, 4000)`, stored as `C1_after_cover`. That key is not `after_cover`. The selected formula at `11/4000` is `6847884599/2500000000000`, which also misses `C`. Emitting that weight beside `69/20000` would drop the one-weight sentence.

Evidence class: scoped proof under the single-writer, single-C1, and positive-gap hypotheses. The rational ray below `C0` is infinite and is not enumerated. This does not change the selected frontier.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` on canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main. Priority revision 8. Catalogue card `supplier-boundary-audit`. Scope status: **refined**.

The card asks for one resolved gap on a latest supplier candidate. Merged #6957 censused the single emitted after-cover. This package takes only open question 1 of that note. The caller question from the same note is merged #6958 and is not retaken. The PR5708 preimage remains with `research/g20-component-stock-gate`.

Overlap on 2026-11-10, with 339 open upstream PR bodies and 7,007 discussion records: the preimage appears in discussion #1166 comments 19492491 and 19507126, and in no open upstream PR body. The phrase "second after-cover" appears only in the #6957 open question.

Package: `research/g20-second-after-cover-obstruction`.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B research/g20-second-after-cover-obstruction/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/g20-second-after-cover-obstruction/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-second-after-cover-obstruction
```

Observed locally: `PASS_G20_SECOND_AFTER_COVER_OBSTRUCTION` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `negative-result`. The optimized command matches. Checks raise `SystemExit`.

Hashes and Git blobs are checked before any `Fraction` evaluation. Controls reject an unbound call, a second `after_cover` key, a bridge key renamed to `after_cover`, a second C1 sentence, and a second controller writer.

Not run: the controller replay, the bridge script, the outer ledger, either component caller, native maps, an odd-prime search, the odd-prime avoidance list, Lean, Docker, and `make frontier6030-verify`. The comparison `2**26 > 256/(C0-C1)` is evaluated only at the kept gap `9/1000000`. At the preimage the denominator is negative.

## Credit

The component is Ali Romman's PR #5679. The selected pricing and claim are DreamingOfClouds' PR #6030. The one-weight contract is Cinna Davis's `research/query-thinned-controllers`. The bridge weight is the retained source in `research/kappa-rebuild/bit`. The single-emission census is merged PR #6957.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. The odd-prime avoidance of fixed denominators and rank witnesses was not executed. It is not the blocker: every cover strictly below `C0` already misses `C`. First step, for a later single cover that restores a positive gap and is checked only for the fallback surcharge: name one odd prime above `2^26*N^5` and the denominator list it avoids. Blocked by the size of the compiled `N`.
2. If `before > after` and `256/(C0-C1)` are dropped, the unique preimage makes this formula equal `C`. That drops the one-weight proof. First step: write the replacement for those two sentences, then read whether `bit_saving` is still `admitted`. Equality with `C` would still leave `bit_saving = 17/5000`. This package does not retake the caller census of #6958.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The open question's first step, naming the second assignment before arithmetic, matched the bridge weight already pinned as a controller input. A link to the feedback discussion is enough: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
